highlights: About 100 acres in Jhaloda, off the Thol–Kadi–Sanand highway, beside a lake: 216 plots
Plot sizes of about 1,100 – 3,989 sq.yd (layout R_28: 597 – 7,913 sq.yd super built-up, including plots sold together)
NA and Vastu-compliant plots with a fruit orchard made for all of them
40 ft internal roads and landscaped avenues
Bore well, underground tank, pump room, percolation wells at the crossroads and servant quarters
